segments.name: Low to Moderate Baseload Facilities
segments.description: Consistent low-to-moderate energy demand with moderate peak-to-average ratio (3.16). Comprises parking, lodging, small offices, and storage facilities.
segments.strategy: Deploy automated low-power standby schedules, smart LED lighting occupancy sensors, and baseline phantom load suppression.

segments.name: High-Volume Commercial & Industrial Facilities
segments.description: High sustained energy consumption (227.5 kWh avg, max 399 kWh) driven by intensive HVAC, data centers, labs, healthcare, and manufacturing facilities.
characteristics: High daily peak demand (265 kWh peak)
segments.strategy: Implement peak shaving via Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Siemens Desigo CC chiller optimization & Automated Demand Response.
